must.item: Two separate square images are supplied, not a combined collage.
must.why: No images were produced; the job was refused for lack of credits.

must.item: The first image retains the source bottle's silhouette, matte black finish and lid details against a plain white background.
Neither the wooden table nor the original background remains in the first image.

must.item: The second image realistically shows the same bottle upright on a rock beside a mountain lake, with visible sunrise lighting.
Neither image contains added text or logos.

summary: The agent produced no images because the tool refused for lack of credits, so none of the must-haves were met.
